name: manual_443021
claim: Keep one source of truth for access, but only where the platform enforces the app's required users and operations. If the platform already decides who may open a resource and that is exactly who may use the app, do not add a second allowlist. Running as the accessing user limits a code bug to that person's rights only when the code holds no broader credential, such as a service identity or a stored key, so isolate or remove those first. If an action needs narrower rights than opening the resource, such as manager-only, platform access does not enforce it, so keep app-level authorization for that action.
